description: This file defines a culture info object for Irish English (en-IE) used by the Date.js library. It contains localized date and time formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for Date objects.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time component of the date to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date object with the same timestamp.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date with another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name in various forms.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns timezone abbreviation given an offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns timezone offset given a timezone name.
